Corrected A1, F3 and 2.1 to record both suppliers. Checked the Christoffel symbols, omega=dx/y, d omega=dA, K=-1 and positive area of a nonempty disk.

The parent theorem and this corollary both assume full AC; the source locator incorrectly called that inherited assumption countable choice. Corrected the locator and A1 to include the parent local summation input. Setting every smooth subdivision turn to zero yields exactly the stated smooth-boundary identity, including empty boundary. No Statement change.

The proof establishes the precise oriented Statement by integrating the zero curvature form and dividing 2pi chi=0 by 2pi. The title omitted the orientation qualifier and advertised a broader scope. Added oriented to the title; no nonorientable theorem is asserted or imported and the Statement and proof are unchanged.

The positivity supplier explicitly uses a choice-free finite-chart integral. Corrected A1 and 4.1 so AC is inherited only through global Gauss–Bonnet. Compactness gives compact support, nonemptiness and K>0 make K dA nonzero and positive, so its positive integral divided by 2pi gives chi>0. No classification is used.

Gauss–Bonnet alone identifies total curvature with Euler characteristic; it supplies no classification argument. The remark incorrectly made classification necessary even for a genus formula, which can instead be obtained homologically when genus is defined via the first Betti number. Replaced the necessity claim with additional topological input and identified classification as one route. The surface versus higher-dimensional scope is unchanged.

The cited torus definition supplies only the quotient-circle product topology. Added the missing local construction: short-interval quotient maps are open embeddings, product charts have locally constant integer transition shifts, and the quotient is Hausdorff and second-countable. Identity transition derivatives glue the metric and orientation; zero Christoffel symbols give K=0. The periodic grid has V=9,E=27,F=18. Removed a duplicate dependency and recorded the structure equation choice premise.

For R unequal to 1 the unit coordinate vectors are not on the radius-R sphere. Replaced them by plus/minus R times ambient basis vectors, keeping them distinct from the tangent frame notation. Radial projection gives six vertices, twelve edges and eight faces, hence chi=2. Checked polar metric, omega=cos(theta)dphi, K=R^-2 and area=4pi R^2; included the symmetric Christoffel symbol and inherited countable-choice premise.
